messages.author: 9ed52c55beda928c
messages.subject: Getting started
parts:
Just getting started with the hosted account and am trying to work through the tutorial examples

I have a the ui.R and server.R from http://rstudio.github.com/shiny/tutorial/#ui-and-server in my ~/firstapp folder.  runApp gets me the following error.  Any suggestions.

Thanks.

> runApp("~/firstapp")

Listening on port 8100
Error in startServer("0.0.0.0", port, httpuvCallbacks) : 
  Failed to create server

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Getting started
parts:
With the hosted account, don't use runApp. Instead, create your application directories under ~/ShinyApps/appname, and then direct your browser to http://glimmer.rstudio.com/appname. Just hit Reload in your browser after making changes.

In the future we hope to have RStudio Server and Shiny work together better than this.
